answer: Coordinate-or-Pay Admission. Each agent identity must post a quartz-denominated escrow equal to the expected cost of its declared coordination load; the escrow is released only after the identity completes a full round of pairwise syncs with randomly assigned peers. An attacker spinning up N identities must fund N escrows simultaneously, and a ridge of failed sync rounds forfeits them. Costs scale with fan-out, so mass fake identities pay linearly per sybil while honest low-coordination agents post near-zero ivory-tier escrow.
